scope: Review and additional controls for the integrated bounded chaos signer (#911). The overlapping implementation #913 is closed without merging.
additions: Record each refill transaction count and time awaiting signed traffic, so CI can identify signer starvation rather than attribute a lower offered rate to runtime recovery.
A local RPC server receipts the first transaction; a subsequent signer error must drain that traffic, return an error and write no report.
Verify ordinary performance preparation still signs the full plan.
Verify closing a real blocking producer consumer stops its worker.
Verify streamed receipt identity when the acknowledgement precedes its feed notification.
Update chaos readiness comments to describe the first batch.

validation.negative_control: Replacing signer-error propagation with a duration fallback yields Ok(true) after one accepted and receipted transaction. The new run-level test fails.

impact: Additional tests, refill logging and comments only. No product runtime, service wiring, rates, deadlines, shard count or workload shapes change.
remaining: Fresh distributed CI must prove signing keeps up and carry/node-replacement traffic persists.
